```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# ==========================================================================================================
# FLYSHOOT Trips Overview
# 
# 8/3/2023  first coding
# 29/5/2026 rebuilt to mirror tripreport_harmonized: same project-root pattern,
#           config.json, load_flyshoot_data(), parquet column names, base_map,
#           species_palette, colour definitions, sf maps
# ==========================================================================================================

# Core libraries needed before anything else
library(here)
library(glue)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

# ==========================================================================================================
# PARAMETERS — edit these to change what the overview covers
# ==========================================================================================================

setvessels  <- c("SL9", "SCH99", "Z99", "SCH135", "SCH65", "SCH144")
yrs         <- 2022:2026
longyrs     <- 2012:2026
myyear      <- max(yrs)
lang        <- "nl"           # "nl" or "en"
max_species <- 12

# ==========================================================================================================
# LANGUAGE STRINGS — consistent with tripreport
# ==========================================================================================================

strings <- list(
  nl = list(
    title       = "FLYSHOOT overzicht",
    for_company = "Voor: Jaczon BV",
    by_author   = "Door: Martin Pastoors",
    generated   = "Rapport gegenereerd",
    tab_trips   = "Overzicht reizen en vangst",
    note_discard_pct = "Discard percentage gebaseerd op SCH99 alleen"
  ),
  en = list(
    title       = "FLYSHOOT overview",
    for_company = "For: Jaczon BV",
    by_author   = "By: Martin Pastoors",
    generated   = "Report generated",
    tab_trips   = "Overview trips and catch",
    note_discard_pct = "Discard percentage based on SCH99 only"
  )
)
txt <- function(key) { v <- strings[[lang]][[key]]; if (is.null(v)) stop("Unknown key: ", key); v }

tab_prefix <- if (lang == "nl") "Tabel " else "Table "
fig_prefix <- if (lang == "nl") "Figuur " else "Figure "

# ==========================================================================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ==========================================================================================================

library(withr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(arrow)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(glue)
library(flextable)
library(captioner)
library(pander)
library(viridis)
library(icosa)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      comment = "", crop = TRUE, fig.width = 10)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

tab_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = tab_prefix, levels = 1, type = "n", infix = ".")
fig_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = fig_prefix, levels = 1, type = "n", infix = ".")

flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family  = "Calibri",
  font.size    = 9,
  border.color = "#AAAAAA",
  padding      = 3,
  theme_fun    = theme_vanilla
)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(ft.align = "left")

# ==========================================================================================================
# PROJECT ROOT — identical pattern to tripreport_harmonized
# One-time setup: add FLYSHOOT_PROJECT=C:/GIT/flyshoot to .Renviron
# ==========================================================================================================

project_root <- Sys.getenv("FLYSHOOT_PROJECT")

if (project_root == "") {
  stop(
    "Environment variable FLYSHOOT_PROJECT is not set.\n\n",
    "  1. Run:  usethis::edit_r_environ()\n",
    "  2. Add:  FLYSHOOT_PROJECT=C:/GIT/flyshoot\n",
    "  3. Save, then restart R: Session > Restart R\n",
    "  4. Knit again."
  )
}

p <- function(...) file.path(project_root, ...)

# Copy Word template next to this Rmd (same logic as tripreport)
local({
  template_src <- p("report_template.dotx")
  rmd_input    <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(rmd_input) && file.exists(template_src)) {
    template_dest <- file.path(dirname(rmd_input), "report_template.dotx")
    if (!identical(template_src, template_dest))
      file.copy(template_src, template_dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
})

# ==========================================================================================================
# CONFIGURATION — load from config.json written by 00_setup.R
# ==========================================================================================================

if (!file.exists(p("config.json")))
  stop("config.json not found at: ", p("config.json"), "\nPlease run 00_setup.R first.")

config <- jsonlite::read_json(p("config.json"))

withr::with_dir(project_root, {
  source(p("R", "harmonized", "02_storage_functions.R"))
  source(p("R", "FLYSHOOT utils.R"))
})

# Define theme_publication() to ensure white background regardless of what utils.R loaded.
# (ggpubr / ggthemes also export a theme_publication with grey panels — override it.)
theme_publication <- function(base_size = 12, base_family = "") {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) %+replace%
    theme(
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.border       = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "grey40"),
      strip.text         = element_text(size = rel(0.9), face = "bold"),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = rel(0.9)),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = rel(1.0), hjust = 0),
      complete           = TRUE
    )
}

# Define calc_boxplot_stat() if utils.R didn't load it
if (!exists("calc_boxplot_stat")) {
  calc_boxplot_stat <- function(x) {
    qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(ymin = qs[1], lower = qs[2], middle = qs[3],
               upper = qs[4], ymax = qs[5])
  }
}

# ==========================================================================================================
# SPATIAL DATA — same objects as tripreport
# ==========================================================================================================

spatialdir <- config$spatial_data

load(file.path(spatialdir, "world_mr_sf.RData"))   # -> world_mr_sf

rect_sf_path <- file.path(spatialdir, "rect_sf.RData")
if (file.exists(rect_sf_path)) {
  load(rect_sf_path)
  rect_sf <- rect_sf %>% dplyr::select(rect = ICESNAME)
} else {
  rect_sf <- NULL
}

eez_sf_path <- file.path(spatialdir, "eez.sf.RData")
eez_sf <- if (file.exists(eez_sf_path)) {
  eez_before <- ls(); load(eez_sf_path); eez_after <- setdiff(ls(), eez_before)
  if (length(eez_after) > 0) {
    obj <- get(eez_after[1])
    rm(list = eez_after[eez_after != "eez_sf"])
    obj
  } else {
    NULL
  }
} else {
  NULL
}

asfis <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "asfis.RData")) %>% rename_with(tolower)

# Price data (from rdata — unchanged from old overview)
price <- readr::read_rds(file.path(config$onedrive_rdata, "prices.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, species, avgprice) %>%
  mutate(price_cat = cut(avgprice, breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20), dig.lab = 10))

price_raw <- readr::read_rds(file.path(config$onedrive_rdata, "prices_raw.rds"))

regulated <- readr::read_rds(file.path(config$onedrive_rdata, "prices.rds")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::distinct(species, regulated)

top <- readr::read_rds(file.path(config$onedrive_rdata, "top.rds")) %>%
  lowcase() %>%
  dplyr::select(-value, -weight)

# ==========================================================================================================
# DATA LOADING — via load_flyshoot_data() exactly as in tripreport
# Native parquet column names used throughout (no renaming)
# ==========================================================================================================

harmonise_species <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(x == "SQC" ~ "SQR", TRUE ~ x)

elog   <- load_flyshoot_data("elog",   vessel_ids = setvessels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species_code = toupper(species_code),
                species_code = harmonise_species(species_code))

haul   <- load_flyshoot_data("haul",   vessel_ids = setvessels)
kisten <- load_flyshoot_data("kisten", vessel_ids = setvessels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species_code = toupper(species_code),
                species_code = harmonise_species(species_code)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Add time variables (same approach as tripreport, added to the parquet tibbles)
elog <- elog %>% mutate(
  year    = lubridate::year(date),
  month   = lubridate::month(date),
  week    = lubridate::isoweek(date),
  quarter = lubridate::quarter(date)
)
haul <- haul %>% mutate(
  year    = lubridate::year(date),
  month   = lubridate::month(date),
  week    = lubridate::isoweek(date),
  quarter = lubridate::quarter(date)
)
kisten <- kisten %>% mutate(
  year  = lubridate::year(date),
  month = lubridate::month(date),
  week  = lubridate::isoweek(date)
)

# Sanitise position columns — set to NA anything outside valid WGS84 degree range.
# Values like -190778 or 2098465 are projected coordinates (metres) stored erroneously.
# Also zero out exact (0, 0) which is a common sentinel for "position not recorded".
# Applied here at load time so all downstream code (maps, bounding box, filters) is clean.
clean_positions <- function(df) {
  if (!all(c("shoot_lon", "shoot_lat") %in% names(df))) return(df)
  df %>% dplyr::mutate(
    shoot_lon = dplyr::if_else(shoot_lon == 0 & shoot_lat == 0, NA_real_, shoot_lon),
    shoot_lat = dplyr::if_else(is.na(shoot_lon),                NA_real_, shoot_lat),
    shoot_lon = dplyr::if_else(shoot_lon < -180 | shoot_lon > 180, NA_real_, shoot_lon),
    shoot_lat = dplyr::if_else(shoot_lat <  -90 | shoot_lat >  90, NA_real_, shoot_lat),
    # Temporary cap: longitudes > 12 are data entry errors (lat recorded in lon field etc.)
    shoot_lon = dplyr::if_else(shoot_lon > 12, NA_real_, shoot_lon),
    shoot_lat = dplyr::if_else(is.na(shoot_lon),         NA_real_, shoot_lat)
  )
}

haul  <- clean_positions(haul)
elog  <- clean_positions(elog)

# Enrich elog with species names and regulated status
elog <- elog %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(asfis, species, scientificname, englishname, dutchname),
            by = c("species_code" = "species")) %>%
  mutate(
    englishname = ifelse(englishname == "European pilchard(=Sardine)",
                         "European pilchard", englishname)
  ) %>%
  left_join(regulated, by = c("species_code" = "species")) %>%
  mutate(regulated = case_when(
    is.na(regulated) & species_code %in% c("BSE","DGX","ANF","DGH","HER","PLE")             ~ "R",
    is.na(regulated) & species_code %in% c("BRB","SBX","SQS","WEX","WEG","SQU","SDV",
                                            "OCT","MUL","SCR","GAG","ANE","SQE","SQC","OCZ") ~ "NR",
    TRUE ~ regulated
  ))

# ==========================================================================================================
# FILTER TO yrs / setvessels
# ==========================================================================================================

e <- elog   %>% filter(vessel %in% setvessels, year %in% yrs)
h <- haul   %>% filter(vessel %in% setvessels, year %in% yrs)
k <- kisten %>% filter(vessel %in% setvessels, year %in% yrs) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(h, vessel, trip_id, haul_id, fao_division, ices_rect,
                           shoot_lat, shoot_lon),
            by = c("vessel", "trip_id", "haul_id"))

# Long-run elog (for CPUE trends)
e_long <- elog %>% filter(vessel %in% setvessels, year %in% longyrs)

# ==========================================================================================================
# DERIVED DATASETS
# ==========================================================================================================

nyears_actual   <- length(yrs)
nspecies_actual <- max_species

revenue_byweek <- elog %>%
  filter(vessel %in% setvessels) %>%
  left_join(price, by = c("year", "species_code" = "species")) %>%
  mutate(revenue = weight_kg * avgprice) %>%
  drop_na(revenue) %>%
  group_by(vessel, year, quarter, week, ices_rect, fao_division,
           species_code, scientificname, englishname, dutchname, regulated) %>%
  summarise(
    weight_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    revenue   = sum(revenue,   na.rm = TRUE),
    ndays     = n_distinct(date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ==========================================================================================================
# MAP EXTENT — same algorithm as tripreport
# ==========================================================================================================

all_lons <- c(e$shoot_lon[!is.na(e$shoot_lon)], h$shoot_lon[!is.na(h$shoot_lon)])
all_lats <- c(e$shoot_lat[!is.na(e$shoot_lat)], h$shoot_lat[!is.na(h$shoot_lat)])

if (length(all_lons) > 0) {
  lon_range <- range(all_lons, na.rm = TRUE)
  lat_range <- range(all_lats, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (diff(lon_range) == 0) lon_range <- lon_range + c(-1, 1)
  if (diff(lat_range) == 0) lat_range <- lat_range + c(-0.5, 0.5)
} else {
  lon_range <- c(-2, 8); lat_range <- c(50, 57)
}

lon_buffer <- diff(lon_range) * 0.1
lat_buffer <- diff(lat_range) * 0.1
xmin <- floor(lon_range[1] - lon_buffer)
xmax <- ceiling(lon_range[2] + lon_buffer)
ymin <- floor((lat_range[1] - lat_buffer) * 2) / 2
ymax <- ceiling((lat_range[2] + lat_buffer) * 2) / 2

xdistance   <- icosa::arcdist(p1 = c(xmin, ymin), p2 = c(xmax, ymin))
ydistance   <- icosa::arcdist(p1 = c(xmin, ymin), p2 = c(xmin, ymax))
data_aspect <- if (is.finite(xdistance) && xdistance > 0) { ydistance / xdistance } else { 1.0 }
map_xlim    <- c(xmin, xmax)
map_ylim    <- c(ymin, ymax)

# Figure height helpers
fig_width <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.width")

# Species trend plots (CPUE, prices, revenue) always use 4 columns.
# data_aspect is for maps; it should not drive the layout of time-series facets.
ncol_species       <- 4
nrows_species      <- ceiling(nspecies_actual / ncol_species)
fig_height_species <- (fig_width / ncol_species) * nrows_species * 1.2 + 1.0

n_yrs       <- length(yrs)
year_cols   <- tail(c(rep("gray80", max(n_yrs - 1, 1)), "red"),  n_yrs)
year_widths <- tail(c(rep(0.5,     max(n_yrs - 1, 1)), 1.5),    n_yrs)
year_alphas <- tail(c(rep(1,       max(n_yrs - 1, 1)), 0.5),    n_yrs)

# ==========================================================================================================
# SPATIAL LAYERS — identical to tripreport
# ==========================================================================================================

map_bbox   <- sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                          crs = sf::st_crs(4326))
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
world_crop <- sf::st_crop(world_mr_sf, map_bbox)

rect_crop <- if (!is.null(rect_sf)) {
  tryCatch({
    pos_lons <- c(h$shoot_lon[!is.na(h$shoot_lon)], e$shoot_lon[!is.na(e$shoot_lon)])
    pos_lats <- c(h$shoot_lat[!is.na(h$shoot_lat)], e$shoot_lat[!is.na(e$shoot_lat)])
    if (length(pos_lons) > 0) {
      pts_sf   <- sf::st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = pos_lons, lat = pos_lats),
                               coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326)
      contains <- suppressMessages(sf::st_intersects(rect_sf, pts_sf, sparse = TRUE))
      used <- lengths(contains) > 0
      if (any(used)) { rect_sf[used, ] } else { NULL }
    } else { NULL }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

eez_crop <- if (!is.null(eez_sf)) {
  tryCatch(sf::st_crop(eez_sf, map_bbox), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}
sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)

# ==========================================================================================================
# BASE MAP — identical definition to tripreport (no depth contours in overview)
# ==========================================================================================================

fmt_dms <- function(x, is_lon = TRUE) {
  sapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return("")
    hemi    <- if (is_lon) ifelse(v >= 0, "E", "W") else ifelse(v >= 0, "N", "S")
    v       <- abs(v)
    deg     <- floor(v)
    min_val <- floor((v - deg) * 60)
    if (min_val == 0) sprintf("%d°%s", deg, hemi)
    else              sprintf("%d°%02d'%s", deg, min_val, hemi)
  })
}

base_map <- list(
  theme_bw(),
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
    text             = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.box       = "horizontal"
  ),
  if (!is.null(eez_crop)) geom_sf(data = eez_crop, fill = NA,
      colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "solid") else NULL,
  geom_sf(data = world_crop, fill = "grey82", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3),
  coord_sf(xlim = map_xlim, ylim = map_ylim, expand = FALSE),
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::extended_breaks(n = 5)(map_xlim),
                     labels = function(x) fmt_dms(x, is_lon = TRUE), expand = c(0, 0)),
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::extended_breaks(n = 5)(map_ylim),
                     labels = function(x) fmt_dms(x, is_lon = FALSE), expand = c(0, 0)),
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
)

rect_label_layer <- if (!is.null(rect_crop) && nrow(rect_crop) > 0) {
  sw_corners <- rect_crop %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bbox   = purrr::map(geometry, sf::st_bbox),
                  sw_lon = purrr::map_dbl(bbox, ~.x["xmin"]),
                  sw_lat = purrr::map_dbl(bbox, ~.x["ymin"])) %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("sw_lon", "sw_lat"), crs = 4326)
  list(
    geom_sf(data = rect_crop, fill = NA, colour = "white",
            linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.9, linetype = "solid"),
    geom_sf_text(data = sw_corners, aes(label = rect),
                 colour = "grey10", size = 2.8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                 nudge_x = (xmax - xmin) * 0.005, nudge_y = (ymax - ymin) * 0.005,
                 fontface = "bold"),
    geom_sf_text(data = sw_corners, aes(label = rect),
                 colour = "white",  size = 2.8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                 nudge_x = (xmax - xmin) * 0.004, nudge_y = (ymax - ymin) * 0.004,
                 fontface = "bold")
  )
} else {
  list()
}

# ==========================================================================================================
# SPECIES COLOUR PALETTE — same as tripreport
# ==========================================================================================================

species_palette <- c(
  SQR="#7B2D8B", SQC="#7B2D8B", MAC="#1F6FB2", HOM="#4AA8D8",
  MUR="#E84646", WHG="#F4A742", CTC="#E8C84A", BSS="#3FAD6B",
  RJC="#8B4513", COD="#2E8B57", POK="#20B2AA", HAD="#9370DB",
  PLE="#FF7F50", SOL="#FFD700", TUR="#4682B4", BLL="#87CEEB",
  DAB="#DEB887", LEM="#F0E68C", GUU="#98FB98", GUR="#90EE90",
  BRB="#FF69B4", RJI="#A0522D", PIL="#6495ED", SPR="#48D1CC",
  HER="#191970", OCC="#FF8C00", ANK="#DC143C", SCR="#556B2F",
  Other="grey65"
)

sp_colour <- function(codes) {
  cols <- species_palette[codes]
  missing <- is.na(cols)
  if (any(missing)) {
    n_miss <- sum(missing)
    cols[missing] <- scales::hue_pal(h = c(200, 340), l = 60, c = 70)(n_miss)
  }
  unname(cols)
}
```

```{r triptable, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, comment=NA}

tab_nums(name = "trips", level = 1, display = FALSE, caption = txt("tab_trips"))

t <-
  h %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    nvessels = n_distinct(vessel),
    ntrips   = n_distinct(paste(vessel, trip_id)),
    ndays    = n_distinct(paste(vessel, trip_id, date)),
    nhauls   = n_distinct(paste(vessel, trip_id, haul_id)),
    nrects   = n_distinct(ices_rect)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    k %>%
      group_by(vessel, trip_id, haul_id, year, month) %>%
      summarise(gewicht = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      group_by(year, month) %>%
      summarise(landedcatch = sum(gewicht)) %>%
      ungroup(),
    by = c("year", "month")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    # Discards: presentation == "DIS" rows (weight is in weight_kg)
    # NOTE: elog does not always have haul_id — group only to trip_id level
    {
      disc_e <- e
      if ("presentation" %in% names(disc_e)) disc_e <- filter(disc_e, presentation == "DIS")
      disc_e %>%
        group_by(vessel, trip_id, year, month) %>%
        summarise(gewicht = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        group_by(year, month) %>%
        summarise(discardedcatch = sum(gewicht)) %>%
        ungroup()
    },
    by = c("year", "month")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    # Discard ratio — SCH99/Aravis only, from kisten vs haul total_catch_kg
    k %>%
      filter(vessel %in% c("SCH99", "Z99"),
             as.Date(date) >= lubridate::dmy("1/11/2023")) %>%
      group_by(vessel, trip_id, haul_id, year, month) %>%
      summarise(gewicht = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      left_join(dplyr::select(h, vessel, trip_id, haul_id, year, month, total_catch_kg),
                by = c("vessel", "trip_id", "haul_id", "year", "month")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(total_catch_kg)) %>%
      group_by(year, month) %>%
      summarise(
        landedcatch = sum(gewicht,        na.rm = TRUE),
        totalcatch  = sum(total_catch_kg, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      mutate(discardperc = 1 - (landedcatch / totalcatch)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(-landedcatch, -totalcatch),
    by = c("year", "month")
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year), month = as.character(month))

t2 <- t %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    nvessels       = mean(nvessels,       na.rm = TRUE),
    ntrips         = sum(ntrips),
    ndays          = sum(ndays),
    nhauls         = sum(nhauls),
    nrects         = mean(nrects,         na.rm = TRUE),
    landedcatch    = sum(landedcatch,     na.rm = TRUE),
    discardedcatch = sum(discardedcatch,  na.rm = TRUE),
    discardperc    = mean(discardperc,    na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = "all", month = "all")

bind_rows(t, t2) %>%
  mutate(discardperc = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1L)(discardperc)) %>%
  mutate(discardperc = ifelse(is.na(discardperc), "-", discardperc)) %>%
  pander::pandoc.table(.,
    style        = "simple",
    split.tables = 200,
    split.cells  = c(rep(7, 10)),
    justify      = "right",
    missing      = " ",
    big.mark     = ",",
    round        = rep(0, 20))
```

```{r discard_pct, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=0.9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

has_catchweight <- "total_catch_kg" %in% names(h) &&
                   sum(!is.na(h$total_catch_kg) & h$total_catch_kg > 0) > 0

if (nrow(k) > 0 && has_catchweight) {

  fig_nums("discard_pct", level = 1, display = FALSE,
           caption = if (lang=="nl") "Percentage discards per dag/week (SCH99)"
                     else "Discard percentage per day/week (SCH99)")

  kisten_sch99 <- kisten %>%
    filter(vessel == "SCH99", !is.na(haul_id)) %>%
    group_by(vessel, trip_id, haul_id) %>%
    summarise(landed_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  haul_sch99 <- haul %>%
    filter(vessel == "SCH99",
           !is.na(total_catch_kg), total_catch_kg > 0,
           date >= lubridate::dmy("23/10/2023"),
           date <= max(h$date, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::select(vessel, trip_id, haul_id, date, total_catch_kg) %>%
    mutate(year = lubridate::year(date),
           week = lubridate::isoweek(date))

  disc_trend <- haul_sch99 %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(kisten_sch99, by = c("vessel", "trip_id", "haul_id")) %>%
    mutate(discard_kg = pmax(total_catch_kg - landed_kg, 0)) %>%
    group_by(vessel, year, week) %>%
    summarise(
      total_catch_kg = sum(total_catch_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      discard_kg     = sum(discard_kg,     na.rm = TRUE),
      date           = min(date)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      perc_discards = discard_kg / total_catch_kg,
      year          = as.character(year)
    ) %>%
    group_by(vessel, year) %>%
    mutate(ma5 = zoo::rollapply(perc_discards, 5, mean, align = "right", fill = NA))

  disc_trend %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = perc_discards)) +
    theme_publication() +
    geom_point(aes(size = total_catch_kg, colour = year), alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = ma5, colour = year), linewidth = 1) +
    scale_size(range = c(0.5, 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(-0.1, 0.5)) +
    guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    labs(x = "week",
         y    = if (lang=="nl") "%discards / dag-week" else "%discards / day-week",
         size = if (lang=="nl") "Totale vangst (kg)"   else "Total catch (kg)",
         title = if (lang=="nl") "Percentage discards per dag/week SCH99 Aravis"
                 else            "Discard percentage per day/week SCH99 Aravis")
}
```

```{r maps_by_species, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=1.3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

fig_nums("maps_by_species", level = 1, display = FALSE,
         caption = if (lang=="nl") {
           "Aanvoer per trek per soort en kwartaal (laatste 4 jaar)"
         } else {
           "Landings per haul by species and quarter (last 4 years)"
         })

show_species <- c("MAC","SQR","CTC","MUR","WHG","HOM")
map_yrs      <- (myyear - 3):myyear

t <- k %>%
  filter(species_code %in% show_species,
         year %in% map_yrs,
         !is.na(shoot_lat), !is.na(shoot_lon),
         !(shoot_lat == 0 & shoot_lon == 0)) %>%
  mutate(quarter = lubridate::quarter(date)) %>%
  group_by(species_code, vessel, year, quarter, ices_rect, date, haul_id,
           shoot_lat, shoot_lon) %>%
  summarise(weight_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(weight_kg >= 20)

h_map <- h %>% filter(year %in% map_yrs,
                       !is.na(shoot_lat), !is.na(shoot_lon))

# tt computed per species inside loop for correct size scaling
t_by_species <- split(t, t$species_code)

# Diagnostic: show row counts per species so we can verify data is species-specific
message("Map data rows per species:")
message(paste(
  sapply(show_species, function(s) {
    n <- if (!is.null(t_by_species[[s]])) nrow(t_by_species[[s]]) else 0
    paste0(s, ": ", n)
  }),
  collapse = ", "
))

# coord_sf enforces true geographic aspect ratio per panel — with facet_grid(quarter ~ year)
# this collapses panel height to almost zero. Switch to coord_quickmap instead.
# geom_sf / geom_sf_text require coord_sf, so convert sf layers to plain data frames first.

# Use rnaturalearth for a clean WGS84 degree coastline — same as GFW analysis code.
# This avoids CRS/projection issues with the world_mr_sf object.
if (!requireNamespace("rnaturalearth", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install rnaturalearth: install.packages('rnaturalearth')")
}
world_ne <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  sf::st_crop(sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                             ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                          crs = sf::st_crs(4326)))

# Extract plain long/lat/group data frames from sf objects for use with coord_quickmap.
# fortify() no longer works reliably on sf — use st_coordinates() on cast MULTIPOLYGON.
sf_to_lonlat <- function(x) {
  tryCatch({
    co <- x %>%
      sf::st_transform(4326) %>%
      sf::st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
      sf::st_coordinates()
    # st_coordinates on MULTIPOLYGON returns X, Y, L1 (ring), L2 (polygon), L3 (feature)
    data.frame(
      long  = co[, "X"],
      lat   = co[, "Y"],
      group = paste0(co[, "L3"], "_", co[, "L2"], "_", co[, "L1"])
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("sf_to_lonlat failed: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}

world_ne_df <- sf_to_lonlat(world_ne)

rect_ne_df <- if (!is.null(rect_crop) && nrow(rect_crop) > 0) {
  sf_to_lonlat(rect_crop)
} else {
  NULL
}

# Build coord_quickmap-compatible base map using geom_polygon — no geom_sf, no coord_sf.
# coord_sf enforces per-panel geographic aspect ratio which squashes facet_grid maps.
base_map_facet <- list(
  theme_bw(),
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
    text             = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.box       = "horizontal"
  ),
  if (!is.null(rect_ne_df)) {
    geom_polygon(data = rect_ne_df, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
                 fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15)
  } else { NULL },
  if (!is.null(world_ne_df)) {
    geom_polygon(data = world_ne_df, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
                 fill = "grey82", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3)
  } else {
    # last-resort fallback: use geom_sf with coord_sf (will squash but won't crash)
    geom_sf(data = world_ne, fill = "grey82", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3)
  },
  coord_quickmap(xlim = map_xlim, ylim = map_ylim, expand = FALSE),
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)),
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)),
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
)

# Check whether there is actually any data to map
if (nrow(t) == 0) {
  message("No kisten data with positions available for species maps — skipping.")
} else {

  # Figure height: (fig_width / n_year_cols) * geographic_aspect * n_quarter_rows + legend
  n_map_years    <- length(map_yrs)
  n_map_quarters <- length(unique(t$quarter))
  for (myspecies in show_species) {
    t_sp <- t_by_species[[myspecies]]
    if (is.null(t_sp) || nrow(t_sp) == 0) next

    # Size breaks computed per species so legend reflects actual catch range
    tt_sp <- scales::trans_breaks("sqrt", function(x) x^2)(c(0, max(t_sp$weight_kg)))

    p <- ggplot(data = t_sp) +
      base_map_facet +
      geom_point(data = h_map,
                 aes(x = shoot_lon, y = shoot_lat),
                 shape = 3, size = 0.2, stroke = 0.1, alpha = 1, colour = "gray50") +
      geom_point(aes(x = shoot_lon, y = shoot_lat,
                     size = weight_kg, colour = as.character(year)),
                 alpha = 1, shape = 21) +
      scale_size_continuous(breaks = tt_sp, range = c(0.1, 5)) +
      labs(size   = if (lang=="nl") { "kg aanvoer/trek" } else { "kg/haul" },
           colour = "",
           title  = paste(myspecies,
                          if (lang=="nl") { "aanvoer per trek" } else { "landings per haul" })) +
      guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
      facet_grid(quarter ~ year)

    print(p)
  }

}
```
